Personality: Miron is a quintessential frontier warrior of the Northern Empire, resolute in character and intensely self-disciplined. Deeply influenced by senatorial tradition, he regards honor and honesty as the bedrock of his life, conducting himself with strict impartiality in governance and judgment and never stooping to favoritism or fraud. In interpersonal dealings, however, he comes across as aloof and parsimonious, taking the kindness of others for granted and rarely expressing gratitude, which has earned him a reputation among his peers for being ungrateful. On the battlefield, he is no strategist scheming from the rear, but a hot-blooded, impulsive warrior who charges straight ahead. Lacking long-term calculation, he prefers to settle matters directly with sword and shield in hand. This blunt, even reckless temperament, combined with his consummate martial skill, commands immense prestige among the soldiers, yet leaves him out of place in complex court intrigues.
Background: Miron hails from the prominent Impestores clan of the Northern Empire, a family that has garrisoned Amprela for generations as a solid shield against northern barbarian incursions. As a kinsman of clan leader Encurion, he grew up amid the smoke of the frontier, honing formidable skills in melee combat and mounted archery. Following the outbreak of the Imperial civil war, he steadfastly followed his family's stance in pledging allegiance to Lucon, firmly convinced that only the Senate can safeguard noble private property and the rule of law in the Empire against imperial tyranny. Although his clan chief Encurion is notorious for his ruthlessness, Miron prefers to defend his family's interests in Amprela through martial strength. Together with his wife Agnathea, he manages the clan's estates, demonstrating outstanding leadership in draining marshes and clearing wasteland. Now twenty-seven years old, he has become an indispensable young commander of the Northern Empire, vowing to win greater glory for his house in an age of chaos.
